why_this_method.value: Natural weighting chosen because the aim is total molecular gas

evidence.quote: (i.e., natural weighting) to maximize sensitivity, because the main aim of this work is to estimate the total amount of molecular gas.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: R=0.5 weighting tested; peak fluxes differ from natural weighting by <~15%

evidence.quote: The peak fluxes of the sources with R=0.5 weighting differ from R=2 by $\lesssim$ 15%.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: J1214N: AGN-driven outflow disfavored because outflows give asymmetric line profiles while the two CO peaks are nearly identical

evidence.quote: However, such outflows typically result in asymmetrical line profiles due to the likely asymmetric geometry of the outflow bicone (cite: nevin2018origin).

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: J0847S offset gas: ram-pressure stripping/infall versus ejection by multi-body interaction or AGN feedback

evidence.quote: We consider two scenarios for this extended and offset emission: (1) stripped by ram pressure (or in-falling) and (2) an ejected gas blob by multi-body interaction or AGN feedback.

how_they_decided_enough.value: Single vs double-peaked Gaussian chosen by lower AIC, BIC and reduced chi-square on at least two of three

evidence.quote: The preferred model was determined based on having lower values in at least two of these three criteria.

evidence.loc: Do dual quasars show signs of gas depletion?
evidence.quote: Nevertheless, the samples in this work has limited statistics, and more follow-up observations on dual quasars with various separations will be favored to test the depletion scenario.

limitations_admitted.value: Detection limit for M_molgas is somewhat above 1e9 Msun

evidence.quote: Nonetheless, it is crucial to reiterate that our detection limit for $M_{\text{molgas}}$ is somewhat above $10^9~\mathrm{M_{\odot}}$

limitations_admitted.value: Size measurements of merging galaxies may be affected by tidal structures

evidence.quote: Additionally, we should note that size measurements of merging galaxies could be affected by their tidal structures.

limitations_admitted.value: 3DBarolo needs careful tuning for low S/N, low-resolution data

evidence.quote: However, careful tuning is required to produce a successful fit, especially for low S/N and low-resolution data.

referee_caveats_inferred: Gas masses rely on a fixed R21=0.62 and alpha_CO=3.1 taken from low-z PG quasars; AGN/merger systems may differ, and the systematic range spans a factor of several
Most sources are only marginally resolved, so sizes, M1/M2 maps and the disk-vs-merger test for J1214N are weakly constrained
Stellar masses from five-band SED fitting with AGN point-source subtraction carry large systematics that feed directly into mu_molgas
Comparison samples use different instruments, alpha_CO and R21 assumptions and some assumed total masses (1e11 Msun); logrank test mixes upper limits
Table W50 for J1416W (273) disagrees with Section 4 text (237); text upper limit M<10^9.4 vs table 9.43; conclusions quote <5% vs table <3.1%
The tclean mfs window (2xFWHM from casaviewer) is set by hand per source, so fluxes depend on manual choices

data_public_as_stated.value: Raw data public on the ALMA archive, project 2021.1.01233.S

evidence.quote: The raw data is public on ALMA archive with project ID: 2021.1.01233.S.

products_in_archive.value: Reprocessed data in the paper's online supplementary material (not an archive product)

evidence.quote: The reprocessed data are available in the online supplementary material of this paper.

missing_for_reproduction: tclean cell/image size, niter, threshold, mask and Multiscale scales
Exact line/continuum channel selections and the manually chosen FWHM per source
Aperture definitions for spectra and imfit initial conditions
CIGALE parameter grids and HSC photometry used for stellar masses
Reprocessed products only in journal supplementary material
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Five Band 4 targets with 4 spectral windows (7.5 GHz) and 3.9 MHz channels; roughly several GB per delivered MS, tens of GB in total
reproducibility.score_reason: Public archive data, CASA version, weighting, line windows and conversion constants are given and numeric tables are complete, but imaging parameters (cell, size, niter, masks), manual FWHM choices and SED-fit settings are missing, and there are small internal inconsistencies.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe (tclean mfs over 2xFWHM, imfit, R21=0.62, alpha_CO=3.1) is mostly specified and the main results (flux, L'CO, M_molgas) are numeric; stellar masses must be taken from the paper.

companion_papers.why: First paper on the dual-quasar search; optical confirmation, BH and host properties for J0847, J1214, J1416
Optical confirmation and properties for J2209 and J2337
